## Turbulence closure: not built {#sec-ch09-turbulence}

<!-- PROVENANCE
pin: snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0 (chengcli/snapy)
sources: OUTLINE.md 9.11; src/turbulence/; src/CMakeLists.txt
status: draft
-->

The directory `src/turbulence/` holds a k-epsilon model and its base class carried over from Athena++
(it includes `athena/athena.hpp`, [`k_epsilon_turbulence.cpp:1-25`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/turbulence/k_epsilon_turbulence.cpp#L1-L25), and reads its parameters
from an Athena++ input file). The library is built from the list of source directories `src_files` ([`CMakeLists.txt:35-53`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/CMakeLists.txt#L35-L53)), which
does not include `turbulence/`, no YAML key refers to it, and no test builds it. snapy therefore has no turbulence
closure: sub-grid transport is the constant isotropic viscosity and conduction of @sec-ch09-viscosity, optionally
shaped in $x_1$ (@sec-ch09-x1profile). The files are not described further.
